marl_in_001.speaker: marl_deeson
marl_in_001.text: New face. Good. I'm Marl — I keep Haven Ridge supplied, which means I keep lists of who owes who. You look like someone who can move between here and the bad places without dying. I could use that.

marl_in_job.speaker: marl_deeson
marl_in_job.text: Months back I cached a toolkit out at the Rustwater wells — real tools, the kind that keep the water purifier running. Then raiders moved in. Get my toolkit back and I'll make it worth your while.

marl_in_job_paid.speaker: marl_deeson
marl_in_job_paid.text: Ha — you don't waste time. Fine. Recover my toolkit from the Rustwater wells and there's coin and gear in it for you. I'll even throw in a little extra, since you asked nicely.

marl_in_trade.speaker: marl_deeson
marl_in_trade.text: Suit yourself. Everything's for sale if the price is right. Take a look — and the offer stands, there's a toolkit of mine in raider hands out at the Rustwater wells if you change your mind.

marl_st_001.speaker: marl_deeson
marl_st_001.text: Is that— it is. My toolkit, in one piece. I owe you, and I pay what I owe. Here. And listen — there's more work if you've the stomach for it.

marl_st_offer.speaker: marl_deeson
marl_st_offer.text: The raiders out at Rustwater answer to someone — a knife-witch called Skell. Long as she's breathing, my purifier parts aren't safe and neither is anyone fool enough to draw water there. Put her down and Haven Ridge will remember it.

marl_wt_001.speaker: marl_deeson
marl_wt_001.text: Word came in on the morning wind — Skell's dead and the wells are quiet. You did that. People here don't say thank you much, so let me: thank you. Take this. It was my brother's, before. He'd want it walking instead of rusting.

marl_idle_001.speaker: marl_deeson
marl_idle_001.text: Still standing, I see. Good. What'll it be?

choices.text: Show me what you've got for sale.

marl_idle_trade.speaker: marl_deeson
marl_idle_trade.text: Caps or trade, your pick. Mind the markup — keeping Haven Ridge supplied isn't charity.

marl_idle_bye.speaker: marl_deeson
marl_idle_bye.text: Suit yourself. If you're out at Rustwater, my toolkit won't fetch itself.
